task04_ni_below_bulk.hint: A positive δ makes Ni on a boundary site cost more than in the bulk.

task04_second_potential.hint: A Ni atom arriving at a filled site pushes out an atom of the other element.

task04_closed_ni_mol.hint: 0.98 x + 0.02 y with the saved closed values.

task04_closed_cu_mol.hint: 0.98(1 − x) + 0.02(1 − y); every site holds Cu or Ni.

task04_boundary_cu_closed.hint: Cu per boundary site is 1 − y, with the closed y.

task04_cu_moved_into.hint: Compare the boundary Cu fraction 1 − y with the starting 1 − z.

task04_closed_excess_atoms.hint: 10(x − y) with the final closed x, not z.

task04_open_excess_atoms.hint: 10(x − y) with the reservoir x = 0.5 and the open y.

task04_zero_closed_x.hint: With δ = 0 nothing drives Cu to the boundary; the piece stays uniform.

task04_zero_closed_y.hint: Same reasoning as the closed x.

task04_zero_excess.hint: 10(x − y) when x and y are equal.
